thread:
leo: idea pitch: 'safe-ticket-snapshot' feature. allow support to open a short, scrubbed snapshot of a request/response pair for debugging, with tenant opt-in and strict audit controls.

anya: good name. can we scope it so its obviously not the raw payload? i.e. "snapshot" implies limited view.

sam: implementation sketch: sampler on the request path emits a scrubbed snapshot variant after existing scrubber runs. snapshots stored encrypted in ephemeral S3 prefix with TTL configurable per-tenant (default 14d). access requires console permission + per-user audit entry.

khoa: infra constraints: we should avoid storing any full attachments or base64 blobs. snapshots must strip attachments and include only top-level context window (e.g., +/- 40 tokens). also add per-tenant snapshot quota to avoid blowups.

dina: legal/exports: EU/UK tenants need an explicit opt-in checkbox and recording of consent timestamp; default OFF for those regions. also if tenant has data residency restrictions, snapshot creation must be blocked until legal signs off.

maria: support flow: a button "Open Snapshot" on ticket that requests a snapshot. if snapshot is sampled-out, show a fallback message and allow request escalation to breakglass which triggers an SRE-reviewed process. button click must capture agent id and reason.

sam: sampling policy proposal: global default 0.2% of eligible requests, with per-tenant override up to 5%. eligible == requests that match support-trace routes and tenant allowlist. we should track "snapshot.requested", "snapshot.granted", "snapshot.denied", and histogram for scrub_confidence.

leo: UX detail: show a small metadata banner over snapshot: scrub_version, sample_mode (auto/manual), confidence_band (HIGH/MED/LOW). if LOW, redact more aggressively and show "Request full review" CTA.

khoa: proto header: X-Snapshot-Request: 1. endpoint will return 202 if snapshot queued. workers will annotate snapshot record with provenance id.

preview-bot: snapshot-runbook -> https://runbooks.internal/redwood/safe-ticket-snapshot (created by @preview-bot)

dina: security: reversible pseudonymization is a NO unless HSM-backed approval with legal+security and full audit. prefer salted-hash pseudonyms for support use (non-reversible). if tenant requests reversibility, require contract addendum.

maria: can we include model input + output but not system messages or user identifiers? support needs the prompt+response flow to reproduce.
sam: yes but limit to token window and strip system/admin fields. also normalize whitespace and mask emails/phones via regex + ML heuristics. store only the masked snapshot.

leo: metrics and dashboards: create a console page 'Snapshots' with per-route heatmap, per-tenant snapshot usage, and retention countdown. expose alert when tenant snapshot spend > 80% of quota.
khoa: cost estimate: small for pilot but indexes will grow. suggest pilot with 3 tenants and a cluster-wide storage cap. also add a nightly GC job that deletes expired snapshots and emits deletion_audit events.
dina: compliance ask: include a data-access CSV export for auditors showing who viewed what and when. retention for audit logs should mirror snapshot retention + 90 days.
maria: pilot candidates: BetaCorp, AtlasApps, and TestCo. i can coordinate outreach and support playbook.
sam: telemetry privacy note: do NOT include actual masked text in logs or metrics. only include counts, size buckets, and scrub_confidence_pctl. trace ids ok but avoid vinculating to user email in metrics.

leo: rollout plan: 
1) internal engineering + security pilot (2 weeks),
2) support pilot with 3 tenants (opt-in only),
3) console toggles for per-tenant enable + sample_rate + retention days,
4) monitor cost/usage and decide GA.

dina: i'll draft the legal opt-in text and required DPA addendum language.

khoa: i'll land the infra PR for ephemeral store + GC + KMS. sam, can you own the sampler hook and metric names?
sam: i'll add metrics: snapshot.requests, snapshot.created, snapshot.viewed, snapshot.deleted, snapshot.size_bytes_bucket. dashboard stub will live in observability.
maria: support checklists: how to request manual review, how to escalate, and canned messaging for tenants. i'll produce the docs.

leo: owners: sam (sam) - sampling & metrics, khoa (khoa) - infra + GC, dina (dina) - legal/compliance, maria (maria) - pilot ops, anya (anya) - product lead.

sam: ack. i'll open ENG-7901 for the sampler work.

preview-bot: ticket ENG-7901 created by @preview-bot

anya: thanks all. keeping an eye on consent wording. next: i'll write an RFC draft and link it here. close thread for now.
